s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic testicular swelling with acute worsening and a palpable mass
salient_findings: Left testicular bloating and dull pain for 20 years
Acute worsening over the past 10 days
Enlarged, firm, smooth left testis without discrete nodules or tenderness
Negative transillumination
Well-circumscribed hypoechoic lesion in the left testis with internal blood flow on scrotal Doppler ultrasound
key_facts: 49-year-old man
Left testicular bloating and dull pain for 20 years
Acute worsening over the past 10 days
Denied other medical history
Left testis was enlarged, firm, smooth, without discrete nodules or tenderness
Transillumination was negative
Right testis, epididymides, and vas deferens were normal
Scrotal Doppler ultrasound showed bilateral epididymal cysts
1.09 × 0.79 cm well-circumscribed hypoechoic lesion in the left testis with internal blood flow
Small left hydrocele
Serum CA19-9 level of 57.5 U/mL
Alpha-fetoprotein, human chorionic gonadotropin, and other tumor markers were within normal limits

shortlist.label: Seminoma
shortlist.why_kept: Leading clinical consideration with a well-circumscribed hypoechoic lesion in the left testis and internal blood flow on ultrasound

shortlist.label: Non-seminomatous germ cell tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Possible diagnosis given the patient's age and presentation, despite normal germ cell tumor markers

shortlist.label: Leydig cell tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Possible diagnosis given the patient's age and testicular mass, although less common than seminoma

shortlist.label: Sertoli cell tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Possible diagnosis given the patient's testicular mass and ultrasound findings, although less common than seminoma

shortlist.label: Mixed sex cord-stromal tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Possible diagnosis given the patient's testicular mass and ultrasound findings, with a range of tumor markers

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of a well-circumscribed hypoechoic lesion in the left testis with internal blood flow and elevated CA19-9 level, along with normal alpha-fetoprotein and human chorionic gonadotropin levels, is consistent with a Leydig cell tumor.

rejected.label: Seminoma
rejected.why: Seminoma typically presents with elevated human chorionic gonadotropin levels, which are normal in this patient.

rejected.label: Non-seminomatous germ cell tumor
rejected.why: Non-seminomatous germ cell tumors often have elevated alpha-fetoprotein levels, which are normal in this patient.

rejected.label: Sertoli cell tumor
rejected.why: Sertoli cell tumors are rare and often have a different ultrasound appearance, and the clinical presentation does not strongly suggest this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Mixed sex cord-stromal tumor
rejected.why: Mixed sex cord-stromal tumors are rare and the clinical presentation and ultrasound findings do not strongly suggest this diagnosis.
